verdict.rationale: Filee's own docs say it converts 1 to 100 dropped files in parallel, that one failure does not stop the rest, and that presets can merge everything into one PDF or ZIP. Its CLI accepts wildcards and whole folders with --json output and partial-failure exit codes, and watch folders convert incoming files automatically. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of bulk runs at scale, and evidence of bulk operations beyond conversion and packing (e.g., bulk rename or other batch actions).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: Drop 1 file or 100. They're converted in parallel, a failure never stops the rest, and presets can merge everything into one PDF or one ZIP.
"filee convert <files, wildcards or folders> --to <format>" (or "--preset <preset>") converts with the app's engines and presets
exit codes are 0 (nothing failed), 1 (some files failed)
Watch folders automatically convert the files that land in a folder and can move the originals aside.
